name: Sol-Gel - Metal on Oxide Support
description: Metal alkoxide is hydrolysed and condensed in alcohol with the metal precursor, then gelled, dried and calcined. Reference preparation: 10 wt% Ni/Al2O3 from aluminium tri-sec-butoxide in absolute ethanol.

step_quantities.note: Alkoxide dissolved in alcohol with the metal precursor
Gel drying - low temperature to limit cracking

route_note: The cost driver is the raw material, not the equipment: a metal alkoxide and a large alcohol volume replace an aqueous nitrate solution. The step library has no solvent-recovery operation, so the alcohol inventory is not yet priced and this route is understated against the aqueous ones.
source: Co-precipitation, impregnation and sol-gel preparation of Ni catalysts for pyrolysis-catalytic steam reforming of waste plastics, Appl. Catal. B 239, 565 (2018)
